visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses wearing a Red Bull branded cap and black t-shirt stands at the entrance of the Red Bull Tetris World Final, gesturing with his hands towards the large colorful entrance sign in bright daylight. (2) Night shot of the Dubai Frame landmark, illuminated with golden lights against a dark sky with a few palm trees in the foreground. (3) Interior of a venue where rows of competitors sit at desks with monitors and mechanical keyboards, wearing large white noise-canceling headphones and focusing intently on their screens. (4) The narrator interviews a male player named Power; both are holding Red Bull cans and smiling outdoors in a desert-like area with modern curved buildings. (5) Close-up shots of the narrator reacting with wide eyes and a shocked expression, alternating with snippets of rapid Tetris gameplay on dual computer monitors. (6) A grand night scene featuring a massive LED screen and a drone light show forming the Red Bull and Tetris logos high above the Dubai Frame, accompanied by exploding fireworks. (7) The tournament stage at night where a young male winner from Turkey holds a glowing trophy high above his head while confetti falls and presenters stand nearby. (8) Informal backstage interaction where the narrator high-fives and hugs another individual, celebrating the event's conclusion in a dimly lit area with red geometric panels.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 首屆 Red Bull Tetris 世界總決賽. (2) [Subtitle]: 在杜拜知名的地標杜拜之框舉行. (3) [Subtitle]: 齊聚來自60個國家的冠軍選手. (4) [Subtitle]: 歷經了兩天的分組排名賽. (5) [Subtitle]: 還有1對1的淘汰賽. (6) [Subtitle]: 欸我在拍手都在抖，因為我很緊張欸. (7) [Subtitle]: 這是我們台灣選手. [Variety]: POWER 老師. (8) [Subtitle]: 不只玩的人緊張. (9) [Subtitle]: 看的人更是心臟快要跳出來啦. (10) [Subtitle]: 你剛剛自己的小心臟也快停了對不對. (11) [Subtitle]: 我想說，這局要輸了是不是. (12) [Subtitle]: 沒有，你跟他真的差一點點. (13) [Slogan]: POWER 把台灣帶進32強了. (14) [Subtitle]: 到了決賽現場. (15) [Subtitle]: Red Bull 甚至把經典遊戲俄羅斯方塊. (16) [Subtitle]: 使用2000架的無人機飛上夜空. (17) [Subtitle]: 創下電玩遊戲史上嶄新的里程碑. (18) [Subtitle]: 在決賽（初選）的時候. (19) [Subtitle]: 這些選手的速度，天啊你看. (20) [Subtitle]: 這簡直不是人類啊. (21) [Subtitle]: 最後由年僅19歲的土耳其選手奪冠. (22) [Subtitle]: 成為了 Red Bull Tetris 首位世界冠軍. (23) [Variety]: Amazing! Bro!. [Subtitle]: Thank you!.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main narrator, 1 featured player (Power), approximately 20+ tournament players and staff in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male narrator wearing a black Red Bull Tetris cap, glasses, and a black t-shirt with a Red Bull Jukebox logo. He carries a small crossbody bag.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between the tournament entrance, the Dubai Frame at night, an indoor/covered competition area with palm trees, a desert landscape with unique organic-shaped white buildings, and a high-tech night event stage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM starts immediately with upbeat narration in Mandarin. The narrator's pitch is high and delivery is rapid, conveying excitement. (2) Sudden transition to a slightly calmer but still professional narrative tone as the landmark is described; background music remains consistent but drops slightly in volume. (3) Audible environmental noise from an indoor venue mixed with distant keyboard typing sounds and crowd murmur. (4) Interview dialogue with a noticeable shift in acoustic space (outdoor wind noise). Narrator and player 'Power' speak with high arousal, ending with a rhythmic 'Give me power!' chant. (5) Fast-paced editing sound effects like digital 'whooshes' and 'pops' punctuate reactions. (6) Atmospheric BGM swell accompanied by fireworks crackling and a deep electronic synth pad representing the grand light show. (7) Transition to loud crowd cheering and applause, with the narrator's voice becoming more ecstatic during the trophy presentation. (8) Final phase features lo-fi casual dialogue with heavy fabric rustle during a hug, followed by the BGM fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Introduction -> Competition Gameplay -> Personal Interview -> Grand Finale -> Emotional Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the high-energy experience of the first Red Bull Tetris World Final in Dubai, highlighting the participation of a Taiwanese player and the innovative drone light show.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video centers on a Red Bull sponsored event, with constant visual presence of Red Bull logos, cans, and t-shirts worn by the main characters.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a classic travel vlog format combined with event reportage, focusing heavily on the brand experience of Red Bull.
